تحتكرن (form VIII)
# تَحْتَكِرْنَ (taḥtakirna) /taħ.ta.kir.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَكَرَ (iḥtakara)
# تُحْتَكَرْنَ (tuḥtakarna) /tuħ.ta.kar.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَكَرَ (iḥtakara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
